title: Digital Quality Maturity Scorecard
text: The maturity scorecard combines development artifact and engineering quality KPIs. A missing metric must be displayed as No Data rather than zero. Review the metric's source and refresh date before recommending remediation.

title: Digital Product Quality Scorecard
text: Current Release Defects and Functional Automation Failure Rate are product quality metrics. A measured value of zero is favorable for both. A missing failure rate with a functional automation count of at least one is represented as zero in the dashboard's merge rule. Keep missing and measured zeros distinct in source records.

title: Security KPI definitions
text: Security KPIs include Veracode Scan Coverage %, Policy Pass Rate %, SLA Compliance %, and Critical/High Open Vulns %. Interpret colors using the configured threshold table; do not assume universal cutoffs.

title: Code coverage lineage
text: SonarQube code coverage can be sourced from QMOMaturityScoreCardSonarQubeCodeCoverage after migration from DEVSonarProductionProjectCoverage and LastAnalyzed. Confirm source freshness before drawing a trend conclusion.
